spec_match.rationale: Tests the spec grammar ::highlight(<custom-highlight-name> | *) directly with insertRule and CSS.supports.

interactive.rationale: Fixed parse matrix plus a free-text selector field; scope and escaped-name experiments run on button press.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Lede states the question; findings answer it with values measured on Chrome 158.

edge_cases.rationale: Twelve spellings, six pseudo-elements, and the escaped-name collision.

references.rationale: Links the feature index (chromestatus.com/feature/5174965228929024) and the spec section.

conformance.rationale: Feature suite passes 8/8 on Chrome 158 and is rendered by the shared support panel.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Driven on Chrome for Testing 158.0.8127.36 (headless, Linux, no flags) via Playwright, 2026-11-27 at 1280x800 and 360x740 DPR3; every control exercised; console and network clean; screenshots read. Screenshot confirmed the "*"-named line painted with the escaped rule and the plain line with the universal rule. Not verified with chrome-devtools-mcp (not available in the cloud routine).

telemetry_health.rationale: support('::highlight(*)') reported once from the real probe; assert() on the primary contract.

design_system.rationale: Colours are CSS variables or color-mix() of them over --bg-ivory; text stays --text-black for AA.

accessibility.rationale: Native buttons and inputs with labels, aria-pressed toggles, live regions, captioned tables in named scroll regions.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: No page-level horizontal overflow at 360px; wide tables scroll inside their region.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Wrap data tables in a scrollable container with tabindex="0", role="region" and an accessible name from the caption.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Each results table is in a .table-wrap with tabindex=0, role=region and aria-labelledby on its caption; wide tables get a min-width and scroll inside the wrapper at 360px instead of crushing columns.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Build Ranges from collected text nodes, register Highlight objects in CSS.highlights, style with ::highlight(); only color, background-color, text-decoration, text-shadow and stroke/fill colours apply; feature-detect CSS.highlights.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Ranges come from text nodes (TreeWalker on the shadow page), highlights are registered by name, rules only use the allowed properties, and the pages check CSS.highlights / CSS.supports before claiming support.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Native labelled controls, visible focus, aria-pressed for toggles, polite live regions for results.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Toggle buttons use aria-pressed, results land in output elements with aria-live=polite, 44px targets.

summary: Accepted: ::highlight(*), ::highlight( * ), p::highlight(*), :root ::highlight(*), *::highlight(*), ::highlight(\*); rejected: *a, a-comma-*, * *, empty, :hover and ::after suffixes. * matches custom highlights only. ::highlight(\*) targets a highlight named "*" and beats the universal rule in paint, but getComputedStyle(el, '::highlight(*)') always answers for the universal rule.
